# CV Studio Pro

> CV Studio Pro is a free online CV builder with premium templates, run from Pakistan for job seekers in Pakistan, India and the Gulf. Users type their details in the browser, pick a template and download a PDF or Word file. Premium designs are unlocked with an access code after a manual payment. Free CV writing guides are published under CV Tips.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://uppalc.github.io/cvstudiopro/): overview, free and premium templates
- [CV Builder](https://uppalc.github.io/cvstudiopro/builder.html): the online builder
- [Templates](https://uppalc.github.io/cvstudiopro/templates.html): 70 CV templates by category
- [Pricing](https://uppalc.github.io/cvstudiopro/pricing.html): price of a premium CV
- [How to use](https://uppalc.github.io/cvstudiopro/guide.html): step-by-step help
- [ATS CV Checker](https://uppalc.github.io/cvstudiopro/ats-checker.html): free rule-based checklist for pasted CV text
